hints: Build a string one position at a time. What are the choices at position `i`?
The letters on `digits[i]` - and the choice at one position never affects the choices at another, which is what makes this simpler than most backtracking.
Recurse with the position and the letters chosen so far; when the position runs past the end, record the string.
The empty input is a special case worth deciding before writing the recursion: it produces no strings at all, not one empty one.
